content: During training, the cost of the discriminator is computed over two batches, one with natural (out-of-domain) sentences INLINEFORM0 and one with (in-domain) pseudo-sentences INLINEFORM1 . The discriminator is a bidirectional-Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) of dimension 1024. Averaged states are passed to a single feed-forward layer, to which a sigmoid is applied.
